ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the inclined plane slopes upward to the right. At the lower left there is a spring along the direction of the inclined plane. Block A is located at the upper right of the spring and is in contact with the spring. Block B is close against the upper right of A; B is also connected to the top end of the inclined plane by a thin string along the direction of the inclined plane. The inclination angle of the inclined plane is marked as θ in the figure. Then reason: Before the thin string is cut, the problem states that A is stationary and there is no elastic force between A and B, so for A the forces along the direction of the inclined plane are balanced. A is subject to the component of gravity down the inclined plane mg sin30°, and the spring elastic force is upward along the inclined plane, so the spring elastic force Fs = mg sin30° = mg/2. At the instant the thin string is cut, the deformation of the spring has no time to change, so the spring elastic force is still mg/2. After the cut, B loses the constraint of the thin string and will press toward A down the inclined plane; A and B are close together and cannot pass through each other, so at that instant A and B can be regarded as a whole accelerating together. For the whole A+B, applying Newton's second law along the inclined plane downward: the net external force is (m+2m)g sin30° - Fs = 3m·g/2 - mg/2 = mg. The total mass is 3m, so the acceleration a = mg/(3m) = g/3, directed down the inclined plane. Therefore, the acceleration of block A is g/3.

method.method_draft: 先从图像确认结构：光滑斜面向右上倾斜，A在斜面较低处并与左下方弹簧相接，B紧贴在A的上方，B还通过细线连到斜面顶端。再从题文读取：θ=30°，m_A=m，m_B=2m，剪断前A静止且A、B间无弹力。剪断前对A沿斜面列平衡：弹簧弹力等于A的重力沿斜面分力，即F_s=m g sin30°。剪断瞬间弹簧形变量尚未来得及改变，所以F_s仍保持该值；但B失去细线后会沿斜面向下压向A，A、B紧挨且不能相互穿过，可把A、B看成瞬时共同加速的整体。对A+B整体沿斜面列牛顿第二定律：合外力为( m+2m )g sin30° - F_s = 3m·g/2 - m·g/2 = mg，整体质量为3m，所以加速度a=mg/(3m)=g/3，方向沿斜面向下。因此物块A的加速度为g/3。
